verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM has a dedicated 'Custom Agent Skill Developer Guide' documenting how to build and load custom agent skills locally, plus a 'Custom Agent Skills' feature listing confirming this is a first-party, documented extensibility mechanism. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer reports of building a skill and confirming local loading works smoothly, and more detail on the plugin format/API surface beyond the doc title.
